facts.text: Colorado College uses the Block Plan, where students and professors take and teach only one class at a time.

sources.title: The Block Plan - Colorado College
sources.quote: Our students take one class at a time, and our professors teach one class at a time.

facts.text: Under the Colorado Pledge, Colorado families with an adjusted gross income under $60,000 pay no parental contribution for tuition, room, and board.

sources.title: CC Launches Pledge to Increase Affordability - Colorado College
sources.quote: For students from Colorado families with an adjusted gross income of less than $60,000, there will be no parental contribution for tuition, room, and board at CC.
